items.stem: Which of the following best describes "variance"?

items.stem:
In this question σ denotes the population standard deviation.
(a) Show that Σ(xᵢ − x̄)² = Σxᵢ² − n x̄².
(b) Hence show that σ² = (Σx²)/n − x̄².
(c) For the data 1, 2, …, 5, find the mean and the variance in exact form.
(d) Prove that, for the first n positive integers, σ² = (n² − 1)/12.
(e) Deduce the variance of the values a + d, a + 2d, …, a + nd.
(f) Comment on why the answer does not depend on a.
items.answer: (a) proof (b) divide by n (c) 3; 2 (d) proof (e) d²(n² − 1)/12 (f) adding a constant does not change spread
items.markingKey: (a) expand (M1); Σxᵢ = n x̄ (A1); AG (b) A1 (c) M1 A1 A1 (d) Σr² = n(n + 1)(2n + 1)/6 (M1); simplify (A1 A1) (e) R1 A1 (f) R1 [Total 13 marks]
